name: Lao Cai Marathon 2026
short_description: Lao Cai Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 18 October 2026 in Lao Cai ward, Lao Cai province, over 5.5 km, 10.5 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: Lao Cai Marathon 2026, subtitled "Dong Chay Bien Cuong", is on Sunday 18 October 2026 and is organised by Viet Jungle Co., Ltd. The event page lists Trang A Pao Square in Lao Cai ward as the venue, with the start line on An Duong Vuong street. Despite the name there is no full marathon: the distances are 5.5 km, 10.5 km and 21 km, along the Red River where it enters Vietnam.

core_facts.venue: Trang A Pao Square, Lao Cai ward (start on An Duong Vuong street)
core_facts.organizer: Viet Jungle Co., Ltd. (Cong ty TNHH Viet Jungle)

faqs.question: Does Lao Cai Marathon 2026 include a full marathon?
faqs.answer: No. Despite its name, the 2026 event offers three distances: 5.5 km, 10.5 km and 21 km. The longest is a half marathon that the organisers describe as running along the Red River where it first enters Vietnam, with a stop at a national border marker along the way.

faqs.question: How much does Lao Cai Marathon 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: The late-tier prices shown on the event page are 850,000 VND for the 5.5 km and 1,250,000 VND for the 21 km. That price table does not show a figure for the 10.5 km, so runners interested in that distance should confirm the price directly with the organiser, Viet Jungle Co., Ltd.
